clinicalNoteTitle: When telehealth isn't the right fit
clinicalNote: Telehealth is not appropriate for every medical concern. Some conditions require an in-person examination, laboratory testing, imaging, specialist evaluation, or emergency care. If a virtual visit shows that a different level of care is needed, we will tell you and help you find the appropriate next step. Controlled substances are not prescribed.
emergencyNotice: If you are experiencing a medical emergency or potentially life-threatening symptoms, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not use this website or an online visit to seek emergency care.
